notes.title: 0608 version update
notes.content:
1. Some stores have increased the inventory limit, and now they can't buy for 0 yuan

2. Adjust the AI of some monsters so that monsters will not be stupid and wait for attacks

3. Treasures have been added to the treasure chest to ensure quality and quantity

4. The immortal body of the great devil has been removed and can be beaten correctly

notes.title: 0531 version update
notes.content:
1. class content is updated. All characters will learn a new talent at level 10. This talent will not overwrite the original talent

2. update the main line and new chapters

3. revise some text contents

4. optimize some career growth values

notes.title: 0527 version update
notes.content:
Adjust the initial resolution of the game to make the overall situation more complete



Slightly revised the initial agility of enemy thieves to reduce the Dodge occurrence formula



Fixed the problem that the archer talent [b] swift combo [/b] could not be triggered



Fixed the problem that two of our Elven archers and shield troops appeared in the second chapter of the first main line currently announced
